findings.detail: Two wrong options repeat wrong options of the earlier question M1-S38-T2, while at most one may repeat. Option C (move the discovery searches into the main conversation and read every raw result) repeats that question's option about running all searches in the main conversation and reading every full result. Option D (switch to direct execution and skip the design phase) repeats that question's option about skipping discovery and using direct execution. The scene also stays very close to the earlier one: a library migration in phases where the main conversation loses its design decisions.

blind_answer.reason: The Explore subagent exists to keep verbose discovery output out of the main conversation and hand back only a summary (3.4-K4, 3.4-S3). Having it return a concise summary of findings, not the raw Grep results and file excerpts, keeps that isolation intact and preserves context for the design phase. B just forwards the same output, C moves the raw results into the main conversation, and D drops the design phase a multi-phase migration needs.
